title: A palindrome check with charAt

blocks.text: `charAt` reads one character in constant time, from index `0` to `length() - 1`. Two indices walking toward each other, one from each end, check a palindrome without building any new String.
Write `isPalindrome(String s)` in `Palindrome`. It says whether `s` reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring upper and lower case:

cases.says: "abca" is not a palindrome: the middle pair is compared too.
"Level" is a palindrome: case is ignored.

concepts: Indices start at 0, so the last character is at length() - 1.
